chunking.character_cap_scope: exact chunk payload, including session header and separators; excludes system prompt and the not-yet-frozen per-episode user wrapper
chunking.greedy_rule: append the next complete source turn only if both caps remain satisfied
chunking.oversize_source_turn_policy: reject; never split or truncate a source turn
chunking.session_boundary_policy: hard reset; chunks never cross natural sessions
chunking.unit: source_turn (one speaker utterance; one canonical JSONL record)

explicit_rules: one management build episode per chunk
paper_alignment.session_boundary_evidence: inferred from Prompt 8's example session-scoped filename pattern, which the authors say was revised to match the store, and the 85-step LoCoMo build trajectory; not stated as a standalone sentence
paper_alignment.source: Appendix C.1, Table 11, Prompt 8, and Figure 5

renderer.image_policy: render official BLIP caption as text; never fetch image URLs
